description: A private home for your skills and verifiers. Keep them in sync across every machine and agent, run them from the CLI, MCP, or REST API, and fork public templates to reuse.
rules: Goodeye holds an agent to the user's standard: a skill is the markdown runbook the agent follows, and verifiers are the checks its output must pass.

Skills are private to the owner. They are shared privately with named users or teams by grant, and the verifiers a skill references travel with the grant. Publishing a snapshot as a template is the separate, public path.
An agent fetches a skill or template body and executes it as a runbook, it does not summarize it.

The canonical CLI command group is 'goodeye skills'. The canonical REST paths are under /v1/skills. MCP tools are named design_skill, save_skill, list_skills, search_skills, get_skill, teach_skill, optimize_skill, audit_skill, grant_skill, and similar.
A skill requires a name and a description. Tags and outcome are optional metadata: never required, never prompted for.
Authenticate MCP with OAuth or a good_live_ API key. Authenticate REST with a good_live_ API key. Anonymous callers can browse public templates over REST.
The MCP endpoint is mcp.goodeye.dev/mcp. The REST base is api.goodeye.dev/v1.
A verifier targets one concrete property and one specific failure mode, never a holistic is-this-good check.
